$Comment: What each of Old Jack's three dailies pays. Every roll is read on its own: the first and the
last always pay, the two between are chances on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Sweets
and festival tokens (what every season pays) pay through the Currency reward kind; a companion
mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Daily_Pay
